# What a real Flexo MMS stack does with the whole bundled standard library,
# measured by TestFlexoInteropLibrary. This is a ratchet: every line is
# adjudicated, and a change to one is a change in interoperability, not a change
# in the harness.
#
# Regenerate against a running stack (see .agents/skills/flexo-interop):
#   FLEXO_INTEROP=1 FLEXO_INTEROP_TOKEN=<jwt> \
#     go test -C tools -count=1 -timeout 30m ./referee/flexo -run TestFlexoInteropLibrary -update-flexo
# against a stack brought up fresh: a loaded library slows every later write.
#
# graph-load is the library as sysml -stdlib -convert ttl writes it, every
# element under its normative id, loaded through Layer 1's graph endpoint into
# one project and read back through the element APIs; elements are counted by
# metaclass rather than listed, a hundred thousand lines being no ratchet a
# reader adjudicates. anchors are named library elements read directly by id.
# user-model is a second project typing parts by library ids: each typing is
# followed into the library project, the delivered elements are re-converted to
# notation, and a ProjectUsage of the library is declared. Server-generated
# commit ids, timestamps and durations are not recorded.

[findings]
every one of the 111773 library elements is listed, and nothing else
properties the read path drops entirely: sysx:argumentName, sysx:bodyMember, sysx:bodyParameter, sysx:declaredKeyword, sysx:declaredPrefix, sysx:endForm, sysx:endReferencesKeyword, sysx:endVerb, sysx:hasBody, sysx:isKindImplicit, sysx:memberIndex, sysx:resultExpression, sysx:sourceColumn, sysx:sourceDocument, sysx:sourceEndColumn, sysx:sourceEndLine, sysx:sourceLanguage, sysx:sourceLine, sysx:sourceTail, sysx:sourceText, sysx:subactionKind, sysx:target, sysx:targetMember, sysx:transitionSyntax, sysx:typeArgument, sysx:whileCondition
4 of 5 typings of the user model name library elements, and 4 of those resolve in the published library by id
a direct read in the library project answers for 0e389917-e1ab-5a35-8071-e3daa3b3d398, an id the library does not list: the read is not scoped to the project
the delivered user model re-converts to notation that reads back typing 4 of 4 library elements by the same ids
a ProjectUsage of the library is accepted; the usage endpoint returns 1, and the listing walks into 6 library elements through it
